name: String.rawEndPos

source.code:
/--
A UTF-8 byte position that points at the end of a string, just after the last character.

* `"abc".rawEndPos = ⟨3⟩`
* `"L∃∀N".rawEndPos = ⟨8⟩`
-/
@[inline] def String.rawEndPos (s : String) : String.Pos.Raw where
  byteIdx := utf8ByteSize s
